purpose: Select one economically distinct historical-only mechanism after Campaign056 using frozen definitions and source metadata only, before any Campaign057 source partition, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return is read.

definition_only_inventory.composition: The 79 definitions reconstructed by the frozen Campaign056 protocol in exact order, followed by terminal Campaign056.

candidate_design_catalog.reason: It compares the stock's normalized within-half absolute-return clock with the same stock on the immediately preceding accepted market session. None of the 80 frozen definitions measures cross-session persistence of the complete intraday volatility schedule.

Signed correlation would mix timing persistence with directional continuation and cancellation, reopening the return-profile, drift, reversal, and response families rather than isolating volatility-clock persistence.
High-low range mass already has terminal entropy and morning-versus-afternoon profile-similarity mechanisms; changing only the session pairing would remain too close to that range family.
An equality-mask comparison would re-express terminal price-update share and price-update clock entropy, with the same sparse-trading confound.

Campaign056 already fixes cross-session amount-clock similarity and Campaign053 fixes same-session amount/absolute-return alignment. Reusing amount would violate the independent-mechanism requirement.

Exactly one preceding accepted market session, 238 fixed within-half absolute returns, equal-mixture Jensen-Shannon similarity, higher direction, and no threshold, filter, subset, fit, model, or combination are frozen once.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_day_over_day_absolute_return_profile_similarity_238b
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A repeated minute-by-minute volatility schedule across consecutive accepted sessions may reflect persistent information-release or execution timing rather than a one-day shock; that schedule persistence may remain relevant from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.formula: For signal session t and the immediately preceding accepted market session t-1, form 119 adjacent log-close returns separately inside each 120-close half, pool their 238 absolute magnitudes x_t,i and x_t-1,i in fixed order, normalize each vector to p and q, compute equal-mixture natural-log Jensen-Shannon divergence, and return 1-JSD/ln(2).
selected_candidate.return_construction: 119 adjacent natural-log close returns within each half; never form the lunch transition
selected_candidate.session_pair_rule: signal session and exactly the immediately preceding accepted local market-calendar session
selected_candidate.absolute_return_semantics: all 240 closes must be finite and positive; exact-zero within-half returns remain at their fixed bins
selected_candidate.normalization: normalize each session independently by its strictly positive sum of 238 absolute returns
selected_candidate.distance: equal-mixture Jensen-Shannon divergence with natural logarithms
selected_candidate.similarity: one minus divergence divided by ln(2)
selected_candidate.missing_rule: Require both exact 240-close grids, an exact calendar-adjacent session pair inside the bound raw interval, finite positive closes throughout, and strictly positive total absolute return in both sessions. Missing, duplicated, off-grid, suspended, flat, or invalid prior-session observations are never bridged, filled, or repaired.

decision.next_action: Complete a separate pre-value overlap audit against all 80 inherited definitions, then freeze one exact coverage-first 80-comparison no-return protocol before implementation or any Campaign057 source value read.
